scope: Isolated native-loader verification only; no model, cloud request, user home, marketplace, or shared registry was modified.

acceptance.question: Does the installed Dcode native loader consume an adapter-generated ordinary Agent Plugin skill from an isolated DEEPAGENTS_HOME, preserve its resource paths, and expose unsupported semantics honestly?

adapter_generated_package_probe.fixture: dcodeWriter.add generated fixture@personal at plugins/cache/personal/fixture/0.1.0, then the generated cache was copied into a separate Mini temporary DEEPAGENTS_HOME and registered there.

unsupported_semantics_probe.fixture: Native registry fixture containing commands/x.md and skills/manual/SKILL.md with disable-model-invocation: true.
unsupported_semantics_probe.interpretation: The installed loader identifies commands as unsupported and its loaded skill metadata contains no manual-only policy. The adapter therefore rejects commands/agents and disable-model-invocation or user-invocable inputs before activation; test/dcode-lifecycle.test.ts verifies that each rejection retains the active copy.

native_manifest_components_probe.fixture: Isolated registered package with root plugin.json inline mcpServers and hooks, .mcp.json, hooks/hooks.json, and a competing .plugin/plugin.json.
native_manifest_components_probe.manifest_boundary: The installed manifest reader recognizes plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, and .codex-plugin/plugin.json only. It ignores .plugin/plugin.json, so dcodeWriter rejects a .plugin-only package rather than claim preserved semantics.

cli_boundary.result: Does not list installed plugin skills. This is a user-skill management view; runtime plugin discovery and PluginSkillsMiddleware are the verified loader surfaces.

commands: tar generated native root to ssh m1 temporary directory; rewrite only the temporary installed-plugin paths; DEEPAGENTS_HOME=<mini-temp> <installed-python> -c '<discover_plugins; load_namespaced_skills>'
DEEPAGENTS_HOME=<mini-temp> <installed-python> -c '<discover gated skill and commands inventory>'
decision: Native loader evidence satisfies the dcode adapter's ordinary-skill boundary. The active Dcode reader/writer registry and profile may support install/update while refusing command projection and user-only skills.
